cues: In eighteen eleven, David Brewster found that at one particular angle, the reflected beam is completely plane polarized: only dots are left, vibrating perpendicular to the plane of incidence.
For glass, that happens at about fifty six degrees.
And look at the readout: at that angle, the reflected and refracted rays are exactly at right angles.
